features.name: Create Task
features.description: Users can create new tasks with a title and optional description
user_stories: As a user, I want to create a new task so that I can track things I need to do
As a user, I want to add a description to my task so that I can remember details about it
acceptance_criteria: User can enter a task title (required)
User can enter a task description (optional)
Task is saved to the database with a timestamp
User receives confirmation that the task was created
Newly created task appears in the task list

features.name: View Tasks
features.description: Users can view a list of all their tasks
user_stories: As a user, I want to see all my tasks in one place so that I know what I need to do
As a user, I want to see which tasks are completed and which are pending
acceptance_criteria: All tasks are displayed in a list format
Each task shows its title, description, and completion status
Completed tasks are visually distinguished from pending tasks
Tasks are ordered by creation date (newest first)

features.name: Complete Task
features.description: Users can mark tasks as completed
user_stories: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress
As a user, I want to see when I completed a task
acceptance_criteria: User can toggle task completion status
Completion timestamp is recorded
Completed tasks are visually indicated
Completion status persists after app restart

features.name: Delete Task
user_stories: As a user, I want to delete tasks I no longer need so that my list stays clean
As a user, I want confirmation before deleting a task to avoid accidents
acceptance_criteria: User can delete any task from the list
User is prompted to confirm deletion
Deleted task is removed from the database
Deleted task no longer appears in the task list
User receives confirmation of deletion

features.name: Edit Task
features.description: Users can edit existing task details
user_stories: As a user, I want to edit a task's title or description so that I can correct mistakes or update information
acceptance_criteria: User can modify task title
User can modify task description
Changes are saved to the database
Updated task reflects changes immediately in the list

constraints: Must work as a single-page application
Must persist data locally (no cloud storage required)
Must be responsive and work on mobile and desktop browsers
No user authentication required for initial version
non_functional_requirements: Task operations (create, update, delete) must complete within 500ms
UI must be intuitive and require no training
Application must be accessible (WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance)
Code must be maintainable with clear separation of concerns
